title: First Suite
prompt: Implement a function slugify(text) that lowercases and joins words with '-' (split on whitespace). Then write a unittest.TestCase class named TestSlugify with TWO test methods covering a normal case and an edge case, and assign the class to the variable SUITE_TEST (the grader imports it and runs it).

tests.name: slugify behaves
tests.code:
assert slugify('Hello Big World') == 'hello-big-world'
assert slugify('  spaced   out  ') == 'spaced-out'

tests.name: suite is a TestCase subclass with 2+ tests
tests.code:
import unittest
assert issubclass(SUITE_TEST, unittest.TestCase)
loader = unittest.TestLoader()
suite = loader.loadTestsFromTestCase(SUITE_TEST)
assert suite.countTestCases() >= 2
tests.hint: Two or more test methods starting with 'test_'.

tests.name: tests actually pass
tests.code:
import unittest, io
stream = io.StringIO()
runner = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=0)
result = runner.run(unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromTestCase(SUITE_TEST))
assert result.wasSuccessful(), stream.getvalue()
tests.hint: Your own tests must pass — the runner reports failures.
